Bill.BriefDescription: Changing provisions relating to dangerous dogs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to dangerous or potentially dangerous dogs; andadding a new section to chapter 16.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The breed of a dog shall not be a determining factor whendeclaring a dog potentially dangerous or dangerous. (2) A dog may not be considered potentially dangerous or dangerousif the dog's threatening behavior or infliction of injury or damage wassustained by a person who, at the time, was: (a) Committing a willful trespass or other tort upon the premisesoccupied by the owner of the dog; (b) Tormenting, abusing, or assaulting the dog or has, in the past,been observed or reported to have tormented, abused, or assaulted thedog; or (c) Committing or attempting to commit a crime.
